nodes.label: CSS Theme System (light/dark/claude)
nodes.rationale: Three-theme design system using CSS custom properties on :root, :root.theme-dark, and :root.theme-claude. Each theme defines semantic tokens (--bg, --surface, --foreground, --primary, etc.) enabling runtime theme switching without recompilation. Dark theme inverts colors for focus mode; Claude theme uses warm tones (amber/stone) for humanistic warmth.

nodes.label: Theme Flash Prevention Script
nodes.rationale: Inline blocking script in <head> reads localStorage key 'mindsmith-theme' before first paint to apply theme-dark or theme-claude class on <html>, preventing FOUC (flash of unstyled content) on themed page loads. Runs synchronously before React hydration.

nodes.label: HttpOnly Cookie Authentication Pattern
nodes.rationale: JWT stored in HttpOnly cookie rather than localStorage — immune to XSS exfiltration. apiClient uses credentials:'include' so the browser automatically attaches the cookie on every request. No manual token management in JS. On 401/403, clearAuth() is called and user is redirected to /login. Share pages (/s/) dispatch a custom 'guest:auth-required' event instead of redirecting to B-end login.

nodes.label: Middleware Route-Based Auth Guard
nodes.rationale: Next.js Edge Middleware checks token cookie on every non-public route. PUBLIC_PATHS (/login, /register), PUBLIC_PREFIXES (/s/ for share pages), and SKIP_PREFIXES (_next, api, favicon.ico) are excluded. Missing token redirects to /login with original path as redirect param. Root path (/) is passed through for client-side role-based redirect by page.tsx. Role validation is deferred to AppLayout and API layer since localStorage is unavailable in middleware.

nodes.label: PracticeView
nodes.description: Two-phase practice flow — Phase 1 (active): customer bubbles with persona inference, user bubbles with structured evaluation cards (hits/misses/technique/grain traces), hint accordion, retry-with-technique and advance-round buttons. Phase 2 (evaluate): coach review with improvements, strengths, champion demo_script, traceable sources linking to reports.

nodes.label: ExplicitStep
nodes.description: Admin audit step 1 — material processing pipeline. Shows a 5-node pipeline (parse/clean/extract/verify/ingest) with progress indicators, material type breakdown, parse status summary, and a material list table with file-name/format/size/status/word-count columns plus a tooltip revealing three-layer cleaning stats.

nodes.label: SkillStep
nodes.description: Admin audit step 2 — skill quality analysis. Displays extraction report card, AI quality verdict (pass/warning/fail based on pass rate and avg score), core methodology patterns (coreHabits + differentiators), 4 metric cards (verified/avg score/scene coverage/needs review), collapsible detail panel with quality distribution bars, five-dimension radar, and scene coverage table.

nodes.label: SceneStep
nodes.description: Admin audit step 3 — scene-by-scene grain review. Left sidebar lists scene tags sorted by grain count; right panel shows a two-column comparison for the selected grain: 'use champion skill' (standard script + expert thought) vs 'common mistakes'. Includes prev/next navigation and a 'practice this scene' button.

nodes.label: ProductStep
nodes.description: Admin audit step 4 — product delivery with three sub-steps: profile (inline edit of owner name/title/department/seniority/opening message + personality/background/knowledge domains/weakness notes), verify (launch ProductDemoModal for pre-publish testing), publish (report output + condition checklist + publish/discard actions). Saves via PUT /admin/skills/:id/supplement and PUT /admin/skills/:id/profile.

nodes.label: ProductDemoModal
nodes.description: Full-screen modal for pre-publish verification. Multi-phase flow: scene selection -> mode pick (practice/qa/demo/debug) -> chat interaction using SkillChatView -> evaluation overlay. Practice mode shows structured eval cards with champion answer comparison, technique tags, grain traces (EXACT/SEMANTIC/PROFILE_GUESS match levels), and full-answer aggregation on last retry. QA mode shows recommended questions grouped by scene tag. Debug mode does exhaustive per-grain verification. Uses useDemoFlow hook for state machine.

nodes.label: useDemoFlow

properties.name: ai-extract-frontend
properties.description: Frontend package manifest with Next.js 14, React 18, charting libraries (nivo + recharts), and Tailwind CSS
Frontend environment configuration. Same-origin deploy uses relative /api/v1 path with Next.js rewrites proxy; cross-origin deploy uses full backend URL with CORS.
Multi-stage-ish frontend Docker image: install deps, build Next.js, serve on port 3000
Spring Boot 3.3.2 backend with JPA+pgvector, Flyway migrations, Redis, WebFlux SSE, JWT auth, Freemarker+POI reports, and Spring AI integration
Minimal JRE 17 runtime image for Spring Boot fat JAR
Five-service orchestration: pgvector DB, Redis, Spring Boot backend, Python AI file parser, Next.js frontend. Prompts directory shared via volume mount.
Monorepo editor configuration enforcing consistent indentation (4-space Java/Python, 2-space JS/TS/CSS/JSON), LF line endings, and UTF-8 charset
Git ignore rules covering secrets (.env), IDE config, build artifacts (target/.next/out), Python cache, logs, uploads, and docker overrides

designTokens.fontFamily: Inter, Noto Sans SC, system-ui, sans-serif

properties.tokenStrategy: CSS custom properties (var(--xxx)) enabling theming without Tailwind config changes
properties.description: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a comprehensive design token system via CSS custom properties. All colors, radii, shadows, and fonts are themeable through CSS variables, supporting light/dark/claude themes.
Next.js configuration with permissive remote image patterns and dev-mode API proxy rewrites to localhost:8080. Production cross-origin deployment requires Nginx reverse proxy or CORS configuration.
Minimal PostCSS config with Tailwind CSS and Autoprefixer plugins
Shared constants module. Currently exports PHASE_LABELS mapping interview phases (opening/storytelling/modeling/closing) to Chinese labels (开场定调/故事深描/模型提炼/收网确认).
Tailwind CSS class merge utility combining clsx for conditional classes and tailwind-merge for conflict resolution. Used throughout the frontend for component className composition.

properties.architecture: sseFetch (I/O layer) -> createJsonHandler/createRawHandler (event parser) -> connectSse/connectRawSse (public API)
properties.renderingStrategy: Each chunk event triggers onChunk immediately (typewriter effect). done events deferred to flush() after all chunks in the same batch to prevent double-display bug.
properties.auth: Bearer token from localStorage (getToken), with credentials:'include' for HttpOnly cookie fallback
properties.description: Project's single SSE parsing entry point. Unifies two backend SSE formats (JSON and raw text) behind a common abstraction. Core I/O engine handles fetch, streaming, buffering, timeout heartbeat. All pages/components must use this module for SSE — no inline fetch+manual parsing allowed.
Environment-aware logger. In production only warn+error are emitted; in development all levels including debug. Outputs timestamped, leveled console messages.

properties.ssrSafety: All read/write wrapped in typeof window check, returning null/noop on server
properties.description: SSR-safe browser localStorage wrapper. Centralized key management for JWT token, user info, and report checklists. All pages and API modules import from here rather than calling localStorage directly.

properties.mechanism: React context + document.documentElement.classList (theme-dark, theme-claude) + localStorage persistence
properties.description: Theme context provider supporting light/dark/claude themes. Syncs class to html element for CSS variable switching and persists selection to localStorage. Uses useEffect for SSR-safe initialization to avoid hydration flash.

properties.authStrategy: localStorage 'c_auth' key (token + user) with explicit Bearer header. Separate from B端 HttpOnly Cookie system.
properties.errorHandling: 401/403 dispatches window 'guest:auth-required' CustomEvent (share page listens and opens register/login drawer). Never redirects to B端 /login.
properties.description: C端 (consumer-facing) API client with independent credential system. Uses localStorage c_auth (not HttpOnly cookie) so JwtAuthFilter can distinguish C端 Bearer from B端 Cookie when both exist in same browser. Share page flows: landing -> guest token -> chat -> limit -> register drawer -> upgrade.

properties.mechanism: Next.js Edge Middleware checking token cookie

behavior.public: allow (login page skip-login handled by client AppLayout)

properties.roleCheck: Not performed in middleware (role in localStorage, inaccessible). Delegated to AppLayout + API layer.
properties.description: Next.js edge middleware for route-level auth gating. Protects admin routes via token cookie check, allows public paths (/login, /register, /s/*, /). Does NOT check roles — that is the responsibility of AppLayout (client) and API (server).

properties.pattern: typeof window !== 'undefined' guard before every localStorage call
properties.description: Universal pattern for all browser storage access: check isBrowser() before reading/writing localStorage to prevent SSR ReferenceErrors. All storage operations return null/noop on server side.

properties.priority: JwtAuthFilter: Bearer header优先于Cookie — 同一浏览器同时存在B端Cookie和C端Bearer时不串身份
properties.description: Dual credential architecture: B端 admin users use HttpOnly Cookie; C端 share page visitors use localStorage c_auth with explicit Bearer header. JwtAuthFilter checks Bearer first, preventing cross-identity leakage when both credentials exist.

properties.mechanism: done events pushed to deferredDones array; executed in flush() after all chunks in the same batch are processed
properties.problem: done event arriving between chunks causing premature UI state reset / double display
properties.description: Architectural pattern to prevent SSE done events from firing before all chunks in a network batch are rendered. Chunks trigger onChunk immediately (typewriter effect); done is queued and only executed in flush() after the batch completes.

properties.mechanism: Tailwind theme uses var(--xxx) for all design tokens; ThemeProvider toggles html class (theme-dark/theme-claude) which switches CSS variable values
properties.description: Three-theme (light/dark/claude) design system using CSS custom properties as the single source of truth. Tailwind config references var() tokens; ThemeProvider switches html class to change variable values without touching Tailwind config.
